name: view_duel_uncork_by_space_and_click
description: Uncorking from the client (design 1.4 and 5.7, contract-m7.md §3) on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. A pack corked with key 1 waits for the next wave; in the window Space is Ready, and with the caretaker Ready from its window's first tick the one horn sounds for both hollows at once. During that wave Space uncorks it, not Ready, but only from 3 s after the horn (before, it is refused here with why and nothing goes out). Uncorked, its creeps walk the rival's road sent by my seat (sent_by), each with the small bottle that glints over it, the pack wells up at the rival's Welling, the stipend's gain starts and the tray's socket empties. The caretaker's pack, which it uncorks itself at 3 s after the horn, comes down my road with its bottles too, and it is told. The next window's cork, made with a click on the tray, is uncorked with a click on its bottle.

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a duel against the caretaker

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').defend(scene)
steps.msg: my seat plays its plan

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').gold_for(2, 400)
steps.msg: the caretaker rival's gold, so it corks in window 2: tier I costs 45 since the sends' pass, more than its fifth of what it holds there

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == first and Game.gold == 255
steps.msg: key 1 corks the first pack of window 2, for tier I's 45

steps.assert: Game.rival_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.sim.seat(2).ready
steps.msg: the caretaker has corked too, and is Ready

steps.assert: Game.wave == 2 and Game.sim.hollows[1].phase == 1 and Game.sim.hollows[1].wave == 2 and horn <= pressed + 6
steps.msg: Space was Ready in the window: one horn for both hollows, early

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').packs_shown() == [] and node('DriftTray').find_child('Tier', true, false).text == 'NEXT WINDOW' and node('DriftTray').get_global_rect().end.x <= 400
steps.msg: during the wave the tray says the next packs come with the next window, and keeps left of the crest's arch

steps.assert: Game.sim.tick < horn + 180 and node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'The cork holds for 3 s after the horn' and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).is_empty() and not Game.is_ready()
steps.msg: too soon after the horn: refused here, nothing sent, and no Ready

steps.assert: node('Mine1').get_node('KeyTab').visible and node('Mine1').get_node('KeyTab/Hotkey').text == 'Space'
steps.msg: from 3 s after the horn the bottle carries the Space key

steps.assert: uncorks.size() == 1 and uncorks[0][1] == ['swarm', 'swift', 'armored', 'winged'].find(first) and Game.my_bottles().is_empty() and node('DriftTray').mine_shown().is_empty()
steps.msg: Space sent its UNCORK, the pack revealed, and the socket emptied

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['pack'] == first and Game.duel_side(0)['stipend'] == 4
steps.msg: the simulation took the reveal; the stipend's gain starts

steps.assert: node('Notice').text == "%s walks your rival's road" % Game.PACKS['hollow'][first]['name'] and count('uncorks') >= 1
steps.msg: it says where it walks, and wells up at the rival's Welling

steps.assert: Game.sim.creep(sent_id).hollow == 1 and Game.sim.creep(sent_id).sent_by == 1 and Game.sim.creep(sent_id).kind == Game.pack_info(first, 0)['creep']
steps.msg: its creeps walk the rival's road, sent by my seat

steps.assert: scene.creep_views[sent_id].effects_shown()['bottle'] and scene.creep_views[sent_id].get_node('SentBottle').is_visible_in_tree()
steps.msg: each with the bottle over it

steps.assert: Game.sim.creep(theirs).hollow == 0 and Game.sim.creep(theirs).kind == Game.pack_info(their_pack, 0)['creep'] and Game.team_notices.has('Your rival uncorked a %s on your road' % Game.PACKS['hollow'][their_pack]['name'])
steps.msg: the caretaker's pack comes down my road, uncorked by itself at 3 s, and it is told

steps.assert: scene.creep_views[theirs].effects_shown()['bottle']
steps.msg: with its bottles too

steps.assert: not Game.sim.over and Game.state == Game.State.PREP
steps.msg: wave 2 cleared on both hollows: window 3 opens

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == second and Game.my_bottles()[0]['window'] == 3
steps.msg: a click on the tray corks window 3's second pack

steps.assert: not node('Mine1').disabled
steps.msg: its bottle answers a click in its wave

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).size() == 2 and Game.bottles_of(1)[1]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[1]['pack'] == second and Game.duel_side(0)['stipend'] == 8
steps.msg: a click on the bottle uncorks it
